summary: Thermal Vent active reload input during ticks 14..20 failed to clear Core Heat when triggered mid-grapple detach on Heliostat Truss.
root_cause_hypothesis: Grapple detach impulse reset the weapon sub-state timer at tick 15, cancelling the active reload window before the vent check evaluated.
proposed_repair: Decouple upper-body weapon reload tick counter from lower-body/tether locomotion state transitions so Thermal Vent (ticks 14..20) remains uninterrupted across grapple detach and slide-boost.
